subject: Final decision: Req-27 Senior Infra Engineer — band exception review / no hire
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Hiring Committee <hiring@redwood.com>; laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Req-27 (Sr Infra Eng) — candidate declined offer; next steps

Team,

Quick update from Friday: Anita Gomez declined the offer this morning. She cited two reasons: 1) total cash request above our posted band even with the counter we sent, and 2) an unexpected counter from her current employer that matched the base. Rebecca at Compass confirmed Anita is asking for a band exception and signing bonus to bridge the delta.

I've attached the final offer we sent (req27_offer_letter_v2.pdf) and the comp bands for Q2 (compensation_bands_q2_2026.xlsx).

Questions for the committee: do we pursue a band exception + revised offer, or close the req and reallocate the headcount? If we pursue, we need finance approval for the exception and an exec sign-off for the additional sign-on.

Please reply with your recommendation; Laura, do you want us to attempt one more outreach with a structured band-exception ask, or do you prefer to move to closure?

Thanks,
Vivek
SVP, Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: req27_offer_letter_v2.pdf (PDF, 34 KB); compensation_bands_q2_2026.xlsx (XLSX, 12 KB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, hiring@redwood.com
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Req-27 (Sr Infra Eng) — candidate declined offer; next steps

Thanks for the update, Vivek.

After discussing with the panel, my recommendation is to close the req for this hire. A few reasons:
- Anita is a strong candidate, but her ask pushes us beyond the midpoint of band 5 for Infra, and the role's current priority doesn't justify a band exception.
- We have other higher-impact infra needs this quarter (observability backlog) where the headcount would buy more business value.
- Time-to-fill is already long; reopening will likely bring similar comps without guarantee.

If leadership wants to re-open at a higher band, I support that only with a formal business case and finance sign-off (we should not make an ad-hoc exception).

Action items:
1) Close Req-27 as no-hire and mark candidate as declined in Greenhouse.
2) Reassign headcount to the Observability initiative for Q3 planning (I will submit a priority change request).
3) Notify Talent and Finance for housekeeping and to update forecasts.

Stephanie — can you confirm you'll send the closure note and update HRIS/Greenhouse so recruiting can stop active sourcing? I'll prepare the short rationale for leadership.

Laura
Hiring Manager, Infrastructure

- Update HRIS to reflect headcount as unfilled and file a reallocation request to move the FTE to Observability (Workday link below).
- Notify Finance that we will not be pursuing a band exception for this req; attach the offer + bands for their records.
- Ask Compass (Rebecca) to confirm candidate's decision in writing and capture whether there's any possibility of re-engagement later (no promises).

I also drafted a short internal rationale for leadership to archive. Please review and flag edits: 
"Recommendation: Close Req-27 (Sr Infra Eng) as no-hire. Candidate declined due to compensation; current business priorities favor reallocating the headcount to Observability. Any band exceptions require a written business case and Finance approval.

If approved to re-open at a higher band, Talent will coordinate with Finance and the hiring manager to prepare the formal request."

Laura — once you sign off, I'll push the closure. Will loop in Marissa for final confirmation.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
